offering_description.value: Dorian LPG transports liquefied petroleum gas for energy producers, commodity traders and LPG importers. It owns and operates very large gas carriers and provides shipping capacity through voyage and time charters.

primary_services.value: Ocean transport of liquefied petroleum gas; vessel time chartering

customer_segment.value: B2B: Energy producers, commodity traders and LPG importers

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Freight charges to transport LPG cargoes on individual voyages; rental or leasing: Daily hire for vessel capacity under time charters
revenue_model.category: project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Owns and operates gas carriers to move cargo supplied by energy companies and traders; service provider: Provides ocean freight and vessel capacity to LPG shippers and charterers

geography_served.value: global: International LPG routes linking North America and the Middle East with Asia and Europe

specialization.value: niche specialist: Seaborne LPG transport on very large gas carriers

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Commercial shipping pools that market vessel capacity to LPG charterers; direct sales: Chartering arrangements negotiated with energy companies and commodity traders

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: International Maritime Organization and flag-state rules on vessel safety, carriage of liquefied gases and ship emissions
